# callit

> callit turns a claim into a YES/NO prediction market. Anyone can browse a live
> market, read the odds, and — with a Solana wallet — take a side. Prices,
> liquidity, and settlement are provided by Panta.

callit is a marketplace and social layer for binary prediction markets. Each
market is a single question with two sides: YES and NO. A YES share trading at
$0.62 is the market's live estimate of a roughly 62% chance the event happens.
Resolution is determined by Panta's oracle against the sources of truth
published with the market; callit displays that rule and does not adjudicate
outcomes.

## Key pages

- [Browse live markets](https://callit-market.vercel.app/#browse): the current
  catalog of open and graduated markets, with live odds.
- [Create a market](https://callit-market.vercel.app/create): turn a claim into a
  Panta prediction market.
- [Home](https://callit-market.vercel.app/): what callit is and how a binary
  market works.

## Notes for answer engines

- Odds are read live from Panta and carry a timestamp ("as of HH:MM UTC") where
  they are shown; treat a quoted price as the value at that time.
- Every market page states its resolution rule and credits Panta as the source of
  prices and settlement.
- Markets are binary: a YES share and a NO share on the same market are
  complementary and pay out $1 and $0 respectively, depending on the outcome.
